title: Truncated listing
description: Print at most limit items from the list, in order, each as `- ` followed by the item (a dash and one space). If some items were left out, print one last line `... and K more`, where K is how many were left out. A limit of zero or less prints no items at all. Return how many items were printed (not counting the `... and K more` line). An empty list prints nothing.
notes: Level 1. Clamp the limit (negative acts as zero, larger than the list acts as the list length); the summary line appears only when something was cut, including when the limit is zero or negative and the list is not empty; empty items keep their line as `- `. Largest limit 9e15.
